The test image's defining feature is the **circular/lens-shaped yellow patches** scattered throughout an otherwise green soybean field. This is the textbook field-level presentation of SCN, not BSR (which tends to show more row-pattern or uniform yellowing). The symptom description for SCN specifically states symptoms "commonly appearing in circular or lens-shaped patterns in the field."
